Every one had a winning side: SHORT (or flat). We were fading momentum mid-RSI in a confirmed down tape — the exact chop-entry pattern that feeds hard_max_loss.

The 9 wins were bounce LONGs that trailed (LTC, ME, ETC, GRASS, BTC continuum) — they caught relief bounces, not trend continuation. ai-trader+ 3-loss streak (ARB/DOGE/LDO) was entirely regime-ignored LONGs. Last ai-trader pick was ARB LONG at 08:41 (RSI 41.6, wrong side) which filled and closed -0.10 hard_max_loss. Corrective action this cycle: WLD SHORT — regime-aligned, precheck PASS all gates, RSI 58.9 (outside the 45-55 death zone), ATR 1.73%. Do not re-pick LONGs until BTC reclaims EMA300 or 5m aggregate flips.

Pending signal queue is still noise: oversold SHORTs (RSI <45) correctly blocked by SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR=45. Gates are working; the queue is not opportunity.
regime_context: BTC SHORT_BIAS on both 15m and 4h. Continuum BELOW EMA300 (106 candles). trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, linreg_alignment 0.75 (all TFs bearish). Volatility LOW (zscore NEG, volume_regime LOW) — grind, not crash. Market phase labeled RECOVERY but acceleration just turned NEGATIVE again; treat as down-tape until proven otherwise. 5m aggregate 111 SHORT_BIAS / 14 neutral / 1 LONG_BIAS. Positioning rule: SHORT or flat. LONG only on verified bounce with trail armed immediately. No blanket long ban — bounce longs that trail still work (see LTC/ME/ETC wins) — but mid-RSI fade longs are the enemy.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED (PostgreSQL 24h, meta_rsi ground truth, n=18):

PATTERN 1 — Counter-trend LONG in SHORT_BIAS tape: 15 LONG trades net -0.33 (53%WR). 5 losses at meta_rsi 46-74 totaling -0.60. WINNING side was SHORT or flat on every one. Root cause: mid-RSI entries (45-70) treat a downtrend as a bounce. Why we weren't on the right side: signals fire long on RSI dip without requiring regime flip. Action: ai-trader must pick SHORT in this regime; human should not approve mid-RSI LONGs while BTC is below EMA300.

PATTERN 2 — SHORT scarcity: only 3 SHORTs vs 15 LONGs in a 111:1 short-bias market. The one clean SHORT win was HBAR pump-chain- (+0.07, meta_rsi 54.5). WINNING side was available all day; we barely took it. Why: signal zoo is long-heavy (bb-bounce, volume-breakout, r2v2 all long-first). Action: prefer SHORT candidates in ai-trader; watch pump-chain- / volume-buildup- fills.

PATTERN 3 — ai-trader+ regime blindness: 3 consecutive losses (ARB, DOGE, LDO) all LONG, all mid-RSI, all in STRONG_DOWN. Signal-level: ai-trader+ 29T 41.4%WR net -0.80 (worst volume signal in the book after volume-breakout-long). Not a disable candidate yet — fix is pick quality (regime alignment), not signal params (brain auditor's job).

PATTERN 4 — Exit mix: 6/9 losses atr_sl_hit, 2 hard_max_loss, 1 stale_exit. No SL misplacement epidemic; losses are entry-side (wrong direction), not exit-side. Stops are doing their job; entries are not.
